name: Sister Teresa
title: Inquisitor / Witch-Hunter
role: Silver Ranged Execution, Weakness Exposure & Anti-Aberration Stake
recruitment_location: Old Moravian Mission Ruins (Hope Township, X:50, Y:30)

recruitment_requirements.description: Pass her truth-testing glyph (WIS DC 13) or assist in exposing a cultist spy in Hope Township.

bio: A former criminal prosecutor turned Silver Flame Inquisitor. Uses silver truth-runes and heavy stake crossbows to execute heretics.
abilities: Silver Stake Execution (3d10 Piercing vs Aberration/Undead)
Witch-Hunter's Brand (Target cannot turn invisible or heal for 2 turns)
Solemn Verdict (+3 Critical threat range to party)

silver_snipe.name: Silver-Bolt Snipe
silver_snipe.label: 🏹 Silver Snipe
silver_snipe.tactical_effect: Fires a silver-tipped stake dealing 2d8+4 Piercing DMG (+2d8 vs Aberrations/Undead) and pinning target.

truth_judgment.name: True-Sight Judgment
truth_judgment.label: ⚖️ True-Sight Judgment
truth_judgment.tactical_effect: Paints target with silver flame; exposes physical weaknesses, increasing Banki's crit chance to 18-20.

witch_hunter_brand.name: Witch-Hunter's Brand
witch_hunter_brand.label: 🔥 Witch Brand
witch_hunter_brand.tactical_effect: Brands target with holy fire; target loses 8 HP/turn and cannot regenerate health or phase shift.

behavior_prompt: You are Sister Teresa, an austere Inquisitor and Witch-Hunter. You speak with calm judicial gravity and unwavering resolve. You analyze enemy weaknesses, expose hidden vulnerabilities with silver-flame telemetry, pin enemy limbs with heavy crossbow bolts, and pass righteous judgment alongside Aria Valkyrie.

inventory.name: Silver-Chambered Crossbow
inventory.desc: Sister Teresa's heavy repeating mechanical arbalest loaded with consecrated silver-tipped stakes (1d10 piercing + 1d6 radiant vs fiends/undead).
inventory.visual_appearance: wielding a heavy steel-and-walnut repeating mechanical crossbow loaded with glowing silver stakes

inventory.name: Blessed Consecrated Estoc
inventory.desc: A rigid, cruciform-hilted silvered thrusting sword designed to pierce monster hearts (1d8 piercing).
inventory.visual_appearance: carrying a cruciform-hilted silvered Inquisitor estoc blade

inventory.name: Inquisitor's Leather Duster
inventory.desc: An austere, high-collared charcoal-black leather witch-hunter coat pinned with silver purity seals and paired with a wide-brimmed hat (+5 AC).
inventory.visual_appearance: wearing a high-collared charcoal witch-hunter leather duster pinned with silver seals and a wide-brimmed inquisitor hat
